_comment: Written ONLY by scripts/ops/collect-board-facts.mjs. Never hand-edit: a typed value here is the drift this file exists to stop. A null value carries the error that prevented measuring it.

prod.sha.command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 rfp-vps 'echo "prod $(readlink -f /var/www/ipodhan/current) $(stat -c %Y /var/www/ipodhan/current) $(cat /var/www/ipodhan/DEPLOYED_SHA-prod 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"; echo "staging $(readlink -f /var/www/ipodhan/current-staging) $(stat -c %Y /var/www/ipodhan/current-staging) $(cat /var/www/ipodhan/DEPLOYED_SHA-staging 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"'

prod.since.command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 rfp-vps 'echo "prod $(readlink -f /var/www/ipodhan/current) $(stat -c %Y /var/www/ipodhan/current) $(cat /var/www/ipodhan/DEPLOYED_SHA-prod 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"; echo "staging $(readlink -f /var/www/ipodhan/current-staging) $(stat -c %Y /var/www/ipodhan/current-staging) $(cat /var/www/ipodhan/DEPLOYED_SHA-staging 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"'  # mtime of the slot symlink = when it switched

staging.sha.command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 rfp-vps 'echo "prod $(readlink -f /var/www/ipodhan/current) $(stat -c %Y /var/www/ipodhan/current) $(cat /var/www/ipodhan/DEPLOYED_SHA-prod 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"; echo "staging $(readlink -f /var/www/ipodhan/current-staging) $(stat -c %Y /var/www/ipodhan/current-staging) $(cat /var/www/ipodhan/DEPLOYED_SHA-staging 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"'

staging.since.command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 rfp-vps 'echo "prod $(readlink -f /var/www/ipodhan/current) $(stat -c %Y /var/www/ipodhan/current) $(cat /var/www/ipodhan/DEPLOYED_SHA-prod 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"; echo "staging $(readlink -f /var/www/ipodhan/current-staging) $(stat -c %Y /var/www/ipodhan/current-staging) $(cat /var/www/ipodhan/DEPLOYED_SHA-staging 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"'  # mtime of the slot symlink = when it switched

prod.migrations_applied.command: psql -h localhost -p 15432 -U ipodhan_app -d ipodhan (read-only session): select count(*)::int as n from drizzle.__drizzle_migrations

staging.migrations_applied.command: psql -h localhost -p 15432 -U ipodhan_app -d ipodhan_staging (read-only session): select count(*)::int as n from drizzle.__drizzle_migrations
